testcase.system-out: Scenario: Change appearance while additional commands are expanded ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon uses the Normal appearance ✔ And the Modify additional command area is open ✔ When the user selects "Text Off" from Ribbon Appearance ✔ Then the Modify additional command area remains open ✔ And its command icons remain visible without their text labels ✔ And the expanded area becomes narrower ✔ And the Modify panel title remains visible ✔ When the user selects "Normal" from Ribbon Appearance ✔ Then the Modify additional command area remains open ✔ And its command labels are visible again ✔ And the expanded area returns to its wider layout
